faqs.answer: The 2-Day Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting is a beginner-friendly, practical course covering dental instruments and materials, infection control, and how to anticipate a dentist’s needs during procedures. 📚
The full course fee is S$600 nett. It includes the course materials, expert instruction, and access to specialised equipment and facilities.
Training runs over two consecutive training days, from 9:30am to 5:30pm on each day.
The course reply template lists the venue as our HQ at Clementi Loop. As another supplied workflow example shows a different venue, our team will confirm the exact venue for your intake.
Use the configured intake list. If it is empty, return the no_intakes_message exactly and do not invent a date.

You may use basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits for this course. Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used. Please check your basic-tier balance at https://sfc.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/claim, tell us how much you intend to use, and submit your own claim.
Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used for this course.
PayNow is accepted using UEN 201841969G. If basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits are also used, the participant must state the SkillsFuture amount and the PayNow remainder.

Eligible NTUC Union members may claim 50% of the unfunded course fee, capped at S$250 per year or S$500 per year for members aged 40 and above. They must pay upfront, attend both training days, and claim through the NTUC U Portal within six months after completion with proof of payment and completion. UTAP cannot be combined with SkillsFuture Credits.
GCE N Levels are preferred. Applicants without GCE N Levels may still be considered if they have basic English reading and writing skills, as the assessment is conducted in English.

Q&M may consider suitable candidates for job opportunities on the last day of the class. Selection depends on work location, schedule, skills and experience, cultural fit, and interview performance, so employment is not guaranteed.

The approved options are PayNow, basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits with any PayNow remainder, or UTAP reimbursement after upfront payment and course completion. SkillsFuture Credits and UTAP cannot be combined for the same course fee.

To enrol, provide the selected intake when available, your identity and contact details, payment method, and the SkillsFuture and PayNow amounts where applicable. The details are collected one at a time and shown in a final summary for your confirmation.
After the required enrolment and payment details are received, the team will prepare an invoice and email the relevant payment or SkillsFuture claim instructions.
Payment screenshots may be sent through email or WhatsApp. Email is the preferred channel.
You can find more course details at https://qandm.edu.sg/Courses/Dental-Assistant/4/Basic-Certificate-In-Dental-Assisting.
